line: Fast horse or slow? Xunzi: the slow one, never quitting, gets there.
Audiobooks only at the gym: 51% more visits, then the boost shrank.
What lasts? Habits are likely to keep going after motivation fades.
Estimated: a morning stretch becomes automatic in about 106 days, evening 154.
Motivation matters too: people who enjoyed exercise tended to keep doing it.
Baseball's Cal Ripken came ready to play: 2,632 games in a row.
Motivation or discipline? A Japanese saying: continuing is power.
Vivekananda: character is repeated habits, and only repeated habits can reshape it.
Patanjali's word for practice is abhyasa: repeated effort to steady the mind.
Pattabhi Jois put it simply: do your practice, and all is coming.
credit: Pattabhi Jois · in Miele, Astanga Yoga, 1996
